definitions.explanation: A work of considerable length, typically used for novels, films, and other creative works. Contrasts with 短編 (short work) and 中編 (medium-length work).

examples.japanese: {長編|ちょうへん}{小説|しょうせつ}を{読|よ}む。
この{監督|かんとく}の{長編|ちょうへん}{映画|えいが}は{三時間|さんじかん}もある。
examples.english: This director's feature film is three hours long.

examples.japanese: {短編|たんぺん}で{人気|にんき}を{得|え}た{作家|さっか}が、{初|はじ}めての{長編|ちょうへん}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}した。
examples.english: A writer who gained popularity with short stories attempted their first full-length novel.

notes:
USAGE:
{長編|ちょうへん} is a prefix-like noun that modifies other nouns to indicate full or extended length. It is most commonly paired with {小説|しょうせつ} (novel), {映画|えいが} (film), and {漫画|まんが} (manga).

CONTRAST:
- {短編|たんぺん} (short work — short story, short film)
- {中編|ちゅうへん} (medium-length work — novella)
- {長編|ちょうへん} (full-length work — novel, feature film)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長編|ちょうへん}{小説|しょうせつ} (full-length novel)
- {長編|ちょうへん}{映画|えいが} (feature-length film)
- {長編|ちょうへん}アニメ (feature-length anime)
- {長編|ちょうへん}{大作|たいさく} (full-length masterwork)
